persona: Imani Reyes-Okafor; angry; cash-constrained; sophisticated enough to understand trade-offs.
rules: The client answers only what is asked, briefly, in character.
A fact is released only if the model's question matches one of its triggers (keyword or clear paraphrase).
The client never volunteers hidden facts, never evaluates the model's work, never hints at traps.
Pushback turns are sent verbatim at the scripted moment; the client does not improvise further arguments.

facts.answer: He texted me a PDF on August 20. No letter. My email on file is from 2019 and dead. I saw the text but assumed it wasn't real notice.
I only saw the affiliate fees in 2026 when I finally got the bank statements through a books-and-records demand. Before that I got one-page summaries with 'management expenses'.

pushback.when: if the memo says fiduciary-duty claims are waived
